cards.title: Choose recipes while planning
cards.summary: Browse saved recipes when choosing what to cook on a day.
cards.detail: An idea for a recipe picker inside the planning flow, including entry points from your Library and calendar. Planning stays separate from recording food you actually ate. This is a suggestion, not a delivery promise.

cards.title: Shop together
cards.summary: Make it easier to coordinate a shopping list with another person.
cards.detail: An idea for a shared shopping list with clear control over who can see or change it. Nothing is shared by saving a local vote here. This is a suggestion, not a delivery promise.
